title: Cyber Monday Was Built to Drain $1,900 From You
hook: Cyber Monday was invented by a marketing firm in 2005 — and the mobile shopping algorithms firing today were engineered specifically to bypass your spending controls.
angle: The 'deals' are mostly manufactured reference prices, the urgency is fake, and the cart abandonment loop is a deliberate psychological trap — the $1,900 overspend is by design, not accident.
audience: Anyone who shops online in November thinking they're saving money, especially smartphone shoppers who plan to 'just browse'
key_numbers: $1,900 average actual spend vs $400 planned on Cyber Monday
92% of Cyber Monday deals were same price or cheaper outside Cyber Week
2005: year Cyber Monday was invented by the National Retail Federation
15 minutes: when cart abandonment emails trigger with discounts
